def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct record ids, fully determined by seed.

    The same (n, seed) always gives the same list. It uses no
    capabilities, so there is no clock, randomness or I/O.
    """
    pre n >= 0
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(n=0, seed=7) == []
    ex make_ids(n=3, seed=1) == make_ids(n=3, seed=1)
    ex make_ids(n=4, seed=2).len() == 4
    base = (seed % 1000003) * 1000003
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(base + i)
    return out
